summary: TRIGGER-DRIVEN end-to-end: Salesforce VendorTrigger fired naturally on Account insert, queued @future(callout=true) -> Azure Function -> Dataverse (HTTP 201). No synthetic calls. Account.Sync_Status__c was automatically stamped to 'Synced' by the handler, proving the callout succeeded.

architecture.namedCredential: Azure_EventGrid_Endpoint (patched at runtime via Tooling API to point at live function URL + extension key)

scriptsUsed: scripts/FireTriggerE2E.cls - temporary Apex class (deployed) that inserts an Account and lets VendorTrigger fire naturally. Required because anonymous Apex uses a different (cached) schema view than compiled classes; UEN__c is visible inside the class but not from sf apex run.

scripts/update-nc.apex - patches the Azure_EventGrid_Endpoint Named Credential at runtime via the Tooling API so callout:Azure_EventGrid_Endpoint resolves to the live function URL with the EG extension key.
scripts/call-fire.apex - thin anonymous Apex wrapper that calls FireTriggerE2E.fire().
notes: The handler's setTimeout was bumped from 10000ms to 60000ms in this PR. Apex's default 10s callout timeout cannot survive a Windows Consumption cold start (~10-30s). With 60s, the @future job comfortably waits through cold start.
